name: mirage
text:
v1.0.70 is released (it includes v1.0.69): https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.70
- 1xBet: found and fixed. One feed names it 'onexbet' and the others '1xbet', so the app counted it as two companies. It is now one, so 'agree' counts go down by one where that happened.
- Bets returning to the list after the error: that is what v1.0.69 fixes. A bet nobody sold stays off the list at that price for up to 30 min. If you were still on v1.0.68, update.
- More 'no one is selling' errors: I haven't proven the cause. My leading guess is a wash with your own bids. The engine now has 600+ bids resting. If your bid on the other side of a market sits at the price you are buying, there is no seller and the order doesn't fill. I haven't confirmed this and I haven't built the check yet. The next step is to make the bet sheet refuse that case up front and say why. Send me one bet that failed, with its game and side, and I'll check it against the bids.
